directive.quote: every refusal and error the engine returns carries the exact site and cause that produced it, all the way to the caller and the log, with no collapsing.

sources.retirement_note: Published old main retired this path in the named commit. Its independent historical source checkout is retained; this change neither deletes old source nor revives its runtime.

preserve: Retain the owner-produced exact reason through wrappers, caller reporting and logging.
Keep existing public codes, effect states, current rights, retries, receipts and recovery behavior.
Keep protected details separate from content-free cause identity and logs.
allowed_deltas: Rust compiler source coordinates, condition tokens and release identity replace optional manually named why strings. A typed cause is mandatory at every engine failure construction.
The optional old why default is intentionally dropped. Source-token inventory, compiler checks and mutation tests enforce the structural rule in the existing build and pre-push owners.
No JavaScript runtime or old account policy is introduced; old source remains historical evidence.
banned_substitutions: A generic wrapper site in place of a known producer source.
New public classifications replacing existing codes, or relabeling known refusals as unknown effects.
Runtime field values, credentials, account paths or raw provider error text in causes or refusal logs.
Skipping tests or weakening the existing push gate.

baseline.source_state: Behavioral principle and exact old source read before adaptation. Historical evidence: docs/every-refusal-names-its-cause.md. No byte ancestry or completed delivery claimed.

proof.qualification: These names identify real controls; final gate and release outcomes are recorded separately after execution.
